title: Jimmy Kimmel Trolls Elon Musk & Rob Finnerty on The Odyssey Casting Remarks
text:
Jimmy Kimmel fired back at Elon Musk over his criticism of Christopher Nolan's casting choices in the upcoming film The Odyssey.
just torched Elon Musk over his The Odyssey casting rant. The late-night host clapped back at Musk’s criticism of Christopher Nolan’s casting with a brutal comparison to one of his own products.
Kimmel targeted Musk for opposing Lupita Nyong’o’s casting as Helen of Troy in Nolan’s upcoming film. The host told Musk to “stay in your lane” after reading out several of Musk’s posts on the topic. , “Who specifically is the a–hole who added DEI lies to Academy Awards eligibility instead of it just being about making the best movie?

He stated, “Helen of Troy was also not real. The Odyssey is a mythical poem. ” He added that Helen “was the daughter of Zeus,” who “disguised himself as a swan” and argued, “It makes no difference to anyone but crazy, angry people what color she was. ” Nolan’s The Odyssey features Matt Damon as Odysseus, Anne Hathaway as Penelope, Tom Holland as Telemachus, and Zendaya as Athena.
